title: Auth Events
description: Signup, login, login-failure rates and signup→first-action funnel. Trend-shape window for cohort onboarding observation.

panels.title: Signup rate (signups/hour)
panels.description: Rate of completed registrations. Filter event_type='signup'.

panels.title: Login failure rate (failures/hour)
panels.description: Rate of failed login attempts. Spike = brute-force probe; ratio vs login rate matters more than absolute.

panels.title: Signup conflict rate (conflicts/hour)
panels.description: 409 conflicts on the registration endpoint. Sustained high rate = users hitting the form repeatedly with already-registered emails.

panels.title: Auth events by type (stacked)
panels.description: All event_type values stacked. Visual ratio between successful auth and failure modes.

notes: signup→first-action funnel needs join with the agent_invocations counter scoped to the user's first action; conventional Prometheus can't do that join. The funnel-class question lives in logs (CP1 user_id contextvar) — the on-call answer is 'grep structlog for first agent.run.start by user_id' or, post-CP5 backend choice, a tail-sampled trace query. Surfacing this as a dashboard placeholder rather than building a wrong metric.
